title: Created Subway Surfers clone in 2 hours.
author: Leather_Tomorrow4993
selftext: holy s... i didnt expect i can get this far in short time. used pixelfork to create the whole game. i found ready-made 3d models from several sources. i will edit this post and credit the creators of models. tbh i was really impressed by pixelfork. its fast and it does not think a lot, which means giving me full control over the game. used game mechanics feature there to reduce the cost of tokens(credits) i did a lot of customisation over ai generated values without asking ai. saved me time and money. i will continue from here and will see how can I push the limits with this thing. i actually believe game creation should not be one-shot. it has to give you strong fundamentals and then you iterate to the final version. at the same time, it feels like you are building with lego pieces) you build brick by brick. after several hours you see your creation. and it feels gooood. please, anti-ai people do not come here to lynch for small mistakes. im not posting it to show how beautiful game i created. this is not even unique idea. its a clone. what i tried here to get closest result to original game in 2-3 hours. thanks 🙏🏼

It’s a good base. I think there is obviously so much room for improvements. You could probably monetise if you can he some features, maybe change the trains to logs and the train tracks to streams? Building could be a jungle? If the log hits you game over, if you hit a barrier game over, barriers could be rocks instead? Maybe add some monkey swings for a special feature that gives you a change of scenery when you get up to a certain level? All in all I think you did a great job for a two hour build.
